series.name: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)
series.notes: Chart 7-1 of the SUN-5-12K-SG04LP3-EU user manual, chapter 7 'Fault information and processing'. 25 fault rows, all Fxx, no warning table on this line. Chart 4-1 LED table again gives Alarm = red led solid light. This is the biggest-selling Deye platform in Pakistan (three-phase 48V with battery). DIVERGENCE FROM SERIES 1: this line adds F01, F07, F15, F16, F21, F46, F55, F62 and drops F35; F15 is 'AC over current fault of software' while SG03LP1 has no F15 at all and uses F18 for the hardware variant. F46 (backup battery fault) exists ONLY here — do not add it to the SG03LP1 or SG01HP3 lookups.

title.ur: DC input ki polarity ulat hui hai

meaning.en: The PV DC input polarity is reversed, so the inverter cannot start string tracking or accept the array.
meaning.ur: PV DC input ki polarity ulat hui hai, is liye inverter string tracking start nahi kar sakta aur array nahi le sakta.

causes.en: PV string was connected backwards at the DC input connector.
causes.ur: PV string DC input connector par ulat kar lagi gayi thi.

causes.en: A string was moved to the wrong MPPT input during rework or extension.
causes.ur: Rework ya extension ke dauran koi string galat MPPT input par shift kar di gayi.

causes.en: Reversed polarity DC input protection device or the DC switch is wired backwards.
causes.ur: Reversed polarity wala DC input protection device ya DC switch ulta wired hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and confirm DC is dead with a voltage tester before touching any connector.
solutions.ur: DC switch kholein aur koi connector chhune se pehle voltage tester se DC dead hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: Set the multimeter to DC volts, probe the string positive and negative at the DC input and read the sign of the voltage.
solutions.ur: Multimeter DC volt par set karke string ka positive aur negative DC input par probe karein aur voltage ka sign dekhein.

solutions.en: Re-connect the string in the correct polarity, using a polarity-checked plug, then close the DC switch.
solutions.ur: String ko sahi polarity par wapas jodein, polarity-checked plug use karein, phir DC switch band karein.

solutions.en: If DC input polarity is correct and F01 stays, the internal polarity detection circuit is faulty — board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Agar DC input polarity theek hai phir bhi F01 rahe to internal polarity detection circuit kharab hai, board level repair chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: DC_START_Failure (DC bus nahi banta)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage could not be built up from PV or battery at start-up, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Start-up par PV ya battery se DC bus voltage nahi bana, is liye inverter chalne se inkaar karta hai.

causes.en: Battery is absent, deeply discharged, or its fuse / connector is open.
causes.ur: Battery mojood nahi, poori tarah discharged, ya uska fuse ya connector khula hua hai.

causes.en: PV array voltage is below the minimum start voltage or a string fuse has blown.
causes.ur: PV array ka voltage minimum start voltage se kam hai ya kisi string ka fuse udd chuka hai.

causes.en: DC boost circuit, driver board or its 12V auxiliary supply has failed.
causes.ur: DC boost circuit, driver board ya uska 12V auxiliary supply fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: DC input polarity fault (F01) or insulation fault (F24) is blocking the bus.
causes.ur: DC input polarity fault (F01) ya insulation fault (F24) bus ko rok raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery first: measure terminal voltage and confirm the fuse and connector are intact.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery check karein: terminal voltage naalein aur fuse aur connector salamat hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string open-circuit voltage and compare it with the minimum DC input voltage in the manual spec.
solutions.ur: PV string ki open-circuit voltage naalein aur manual spec ke minimum DC input voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Resolve F01, F23, F24 or any other present code first — F07 is often only the symptom.
solutions.ur: Pehle F01, F23, F24 ya koi bhi mojood code theek karein, F07 aksar sirf ishara hota hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter as the manual says; if the fault still exists contact Deye support.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter restart karein; fault phir bhi rahe to Deye support se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Bus still will not build with good battery and PV: the 12V auxiliary supply and driver board need bench repair.
solutions.ur: Battery aur PV theek hone par bhi bus na bane to 12V auxiliary supply aur driver board ko bench repair karwana padega.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Working mode change ki indication

meaning.en: Not a real fault. F13 is raised when grid type or frequency changes, when battery mode is changed to No battery, and on some old firmware after a work-mode change.
meaning.ur: Ye asli fault nahi. Grid type ya frequency badalne par, battery mode ko No battery karne par, aur kuch purane firmware par work mode change par F13 aata hai.

causes.en: Grid type and frequency settings were changed during commissioning.
causes.ur: Commissioning ke dauran grid type aur frequency ki setting badli gayi.

causes.en: Battery mode was changed to No battery mode.
causes.ur: Battery mode ko No battery mode par kiya gaya.

causes.en: Older firmware reports F13 on any system work mode change.
causes.ur: Purana firmware har system work mode change par F13 report karta hai.

solutions.en: Wait a minute — the manual says F13 generally disappears automatically.
solutions.ur: Ek minute intezaar karein, manual ke mutabiq F13 khud ba khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Still showing: turn off the DC switch and AC switch, wait one minute, then turn them back on.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi dikh raha ho to DC switch aur AC switch off karein, ek minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Note down the grid type, frequency and battery mode you set — support will ask for these.
solutions.ur: Jo grid type, frequency aur battery mode set kiya usay likh lein, support ye poochega.

solutions.en: Code returns on every boot with no change made, contact Deye service.
solutions.ur: Koi change kiye baghair har restart par code aaye to Deye service se rabta karein.

notes.en: Kept as isFault true because it is printed inside the fault chart, but the manual treats it as self-clearing — not a dealer trip.
notes.ur: Fault chart mein likha hai is liye isFault true hai, lekin manual isay apne aap clear hone wali baat batata hai, dealer jaane ki zaroorat nahi.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

aliases: AC over current fault of software

title.en: AC over current fault of software
title.ur: Software wala AC over current fault

meaning.en: The inverter's own software detected over current on the AC side of the backup and common load output.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke apne software ne backup aur common load output ke AC side par over current detect kiya.

causes.en: Combined backup plus common load power is above the inverter rating.
causes.ur: Backup aur common load ki mil kar power inverter ki rating se upar hai.

causes.en: AC current sensing wiring to the control board is loose.
causes.ur: Control board tak AC current sensing ki wiring loose hai.

causes.en: Inrush from a large motor, chiller or compressor starting on the backup output.
causes.ur: Backup output par kisi bare motor, chiller ya compressor ke start ka inrush.

causes.en: Three-phase load is very unbalanced, pushing current on one phase past its limit.
causes.ur: Three-phase load bahut unbalanced hai, jis se aik phase ka current uski limit cross kar gaya.

solutions.en: Switch off AC and DC, list every backup and common load in watts, and find the total.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke har backup aur common load ko watts mein likhein aur total nikalein.

solutions.en: Remove the largest load, power up again and see if F15 clears.
solutions.ur: Sabse bhaari load hata dein, dobara power dein aur dekhein ke F15 clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With the unit off, check the AC current sensor connector on the control board is fully seated.
solutions.ur: Unit off karke check karein ke control board ka AC current sensor connector poora baitha hua hai.

solutions.en: Stagger the big three-phase loads so they do not all start together, or use a soft starter on the motor.
solutions.ur: Bhaari three-phase loads ko alag alag chalu karein taake sath start na hon, ya motor par soft starter lagayein.

solutions.en: F15 reappears on a light balanced load: the current sensing circuit or firmware needs Deye service.
solutions.ur: Halke aur balanced load par bhi F15 aaye to current sensing circuit ya firmware ke liye Deye service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: AC leakage current fault, GFCI trigger hua

meaning.en: The GFCI/leakage detector has tripped on the AC side. The inverter shuts the AC output off until the leakage is found.
meaning.ur: AC side par GFCI ya leakage detector trigger ho gaya hai. Inverter leakage dhoondne tak AC output band kar deta hai.

causes.en: PV side cable or its ground connection is not correct.
causes.ur: PV side ka cable ya uska ground connection theek nahi hai.

causes.en: A leaking appliance on the backup or common load is faulting to earth.
causes.ur: Backup ya common load par koi appliance earth ke sath leak kar rahi hai.

causes.en: Moisture in a junction box, outdoor socket or AC outlet.
causes.ur: Junction box, outdoor socket ya AC outlet mein nama aa chuka hai.

causes.en: The leakage current sensor or its detection circuit has drifted.
causes.ur: Leakage current sensor ya uska detection circuit drift kar gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV side cable ground connection first — this is the manual's own step 1.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV side cable ka ground connection check karein, yehi manual ka step 1 hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and unplug loads on the backup and common load one by one, re-energising after each, to find the leaking item.
solutions.ur: Backup aur common load ke loads ek ek karke band kar ke nikalein, har baar dobara power de kar, leak karne wala cheez dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Use a clamp meter on the earth/neutral conductor of the AC input and watch the leakage current in mA.
solutions.ur: AC input ki earth ya neutral conductor par clamp meter lagayein aur leakage current mA mein dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart the system two or three times as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq system do ya teen baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Fault remains with everything unplugged: inspect the leakage sensor and detection circuit — board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch nikalne par bhi fault rahe to leakage sensor aur detection circuit dekhein, board level repair chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

aliases: AC over current fault of hardware

title.en: AC over current fault of the hardware
title.ur: Hardware wala AC over current fault

meaning.en: The hardware measured AC side over current, unlike F15 which is the software detection. Output is cut until it clears.
meaning.ur: Hardware ne AC side par over current measure kiya hai, F15 software detection hai. Fault clear hone tak output band rehta hai.

causes.en: Backup load plus common load power exceeds the allowed range.
causes.ur: Backup load aur common load ki power ijazat shuda range cross kar gayi.

causes.en: The hardware over-current comparison point has drifted on this unit.
causes.ur: Is unit par hardware ka over current comparison point drift kar gaya hai.

causes.en: Current sensor or its harness on the power board is faulty.
causes.ur: Power board ka current sensor ya uski harness kharab hai.

solutions.en: Open the AC and DC switches and reduce the backup and common load first.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur DC switch khol ke backup aur common load kam karein.

solutions.en: Clamp-meter each phase of the load and confirm the current is inside the rated output current.
solutions.ur: Har phase ka load clamp meter se naalein aur check karein ke current rated output current ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Restart and check whether the unit returns to normal, as the manual's step 2 says.
solutions.ur: Manual ke step 2 ke mutabiq restart karke dekhein ke unit normal par wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: F18 on a light load points to the current sensor or power board — that is a board-level replacement.
solutions.ur: Halkay load par F18 ka matlab hai ke current sensor ya power board kharab hai, board level replacement hoga.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

aliases: DC over current fault of the hardware

title.en: DC over current fault of the hardware
title.ur: Hardware wala DC over current fault

meaning.en: Hardware over current on the DC side from PV or battery. In off-grid mode a very large startup load can also cause it.
meaning.ur: PV ya battery se DC side par hardware over current. Off-grid mode mein bohat bare startup load par bhi ye aata hai.

causes.en: PV module or battery connection is loose, shorted or on the wrong cable.
causes.ur: PV module ya battery ka connection loose, short ya galat cable par hai.

causes.en: Inverter started with a very large off-grid load connected.
causes.ur: Inverter bohat bare off-grid load jure hote hue start hua.

causes.en: DC current sensor or its detection circuit has failed.
causes.ur: DC current sensor ya uska detection circuit fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC and AC switches, wait one minute, then close them again to retry.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC switch khol ke ek minute intezaar karein, phir band karke dobara try karein.

solutions.en: With DC switch open, check every PV and battery connector for full insertion and correct polarity.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke har PV aur battery connector ki poori seating aur sahi polarity check karein.

solutions.en: If it tripped in off-grid startup, reduce the load power connected before retrying.
solutions.ur: Agar off-grid startup par aaya tha to retry se pehle jura hua load power kam kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure PV and battery voltage with a multimeter and confirm both sit inside the manual's DC window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se PV aur battery voltage naalein aur confirm karein ke dono manual ke DC range ke andar hain.

solutions.en: Repetitive F20 with correct wiring and reduced load means the DC current sensor is faulty.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek aur load kam hone par baar baar F20 ka matlab hai ke DC current sensor kharab hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: BUS over current, high voltage bus par

meaning.en: The DC busbar has drawn over current. The manual points at the PV input and battery current settings first.
meaning.ur: DC busbar ne over current liya hai. Manual sab se pehle PV input aur battery current ki setting check karne ko kehta hai.

causes.en: PV input current or battery current limit is set wrong for the fitted hardware.
causes.ur: PV input current ya battery current ki limit lagay huay hardware ke liye galat set hai.

causes.en: Actual PV or battery current exceeds the value entered in the settings.
causes.ur: Asli PV ya battery current settings mein dali gayi value se zyada hai.

causes.en: Busbar voltage sensing has drifted so the control loop over-drives the bus.
causes.ur: Busbar voltage sensing drift kar gaya hai jis se control loop bus par zyada current chala raha hai.

causes.en: Fault repeats after a firmware update that does not match the hardware.
causes.ur: Firmware update ke baad fault dobara aaya jo hardware se match nahi karta.

solutions.en: Open the AC and DC switches before entering any current setting.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi current setting badalne se pehle AC aur DC switch off karein.

solutions.en: Read the actual PV string current and battery charge/discharge current with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal PV string current aur battery charge ya discharge current naalein.

solutions.en: Compare those readings with the PV input current and battery current values in the settings menu and correct them to the real array.
solutions.ur: Un readings ko settings menu ke PV input current aur battery current values se compare karke asal array ke mutabiq theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system two to three times and watch whether F21 clears.
solutions.ur: System do se teen baar restart karein aur dekhein ke F21 clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Fault stays with correct settings: check the firmware version matches the hardware, then send for service.
solutions.ur: Settings theek hone par bhi fault rahe to check karein ke firmware version hardware se match karta hai, phir service ke liye bhejein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Emergency stop ya remote shutdown

meaning.en: The inverter has been remotely shut down, so the manual's only instruction is that the inverter is remotely controlled and the installer must be contacted.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko remotely band kiya gaya hai, is liye manual ka sirf itna kehta hai ke inverter remote control ho raha hai aur installer se rabta karein.

causes.en: A stop command was sent from the Deye app, cloud or datalogger.
causes.ur: Deye app, cloud ya datalogger se stop command bheja gaya.

causes.en: Generator or smart-switch dry contact is asserted by the site wiring.
causes.ur: Generator ya smart switch ka dry contact site wiring se assert kar diya gaya.

causes.en: Smart meter link loss and the fail-safe action is set to stop.
causes.ur: Smart meter ka link kat gaya aur fail-safe action stop par set hai.

solutions.en: Open the Deye app or logger and look for a stop command; clear it before restarting.
solutions.ur: Deye app ya logger khol ke stop command dhoondhein; restart se pehle use clear kar dein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the generator and smart-switch dry contacts for a shorted or miswired terminal.
solutions.ur: Power off karke generator aur smart switch ke dry contacts ki short ya galat wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle DC and AC and confirm whether the code stays away.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC ko cycle karke confirm karein ke code dobara nahi aata.

solutions.en: If nothing was commanded, contact the installer as the manual says — this code is not a user-level repair.
solutions.ur: Agar kisi ne koi command nahi diya to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein, ye code user level par repair nahi hota.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

aliases: Tz_GFCI_OC_ current is transient over current

title.ur: Leakage current ka transient over current

meaning.en: A transient leakage current was detected. The manual's first check is the PV side cable ground connection, then two to three restarts.
meaning.ur: Ek transient leakage current detect hua. Manual ka pehla check PV side cable ka ground connection hai, phir do se teen restart.

causes.en: PV side cable ground connection is loose or not made at all.
causes.ur: PV side cable ka ground connection loose hai ya bana hi nahi.

causes.en: Wet DC connectors or a PV junction box after rain, dust or fog.
causes.ur: Baarish, dhool ya dhund ke baad geele DC connectors ya PV junction box.

causes.en: Damaged cable insulation touching the frame or the PE conductor.
causes.ur: Kharab cable insulation frame ya PE conductor ko chhu rahi hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV side cable ground connection and re-make the earth termination properly.
solutions.ur: PV side cable ka ground connection check karein aur earth termination dobara theek tareeqe se banayein.

solutions.en: Restart the system two to three times as the manual directs and note whether it stays clear.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq system do se teen baar restart karein aur likhein ke fault nahi aata.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, insulation-test each PV string and compare with the module datasheet.
solutions.ur: DC isolate karke har PV string ka insulation test karein aur module datasheet se compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace wet or heat-damaged DC connectors, then re-test before putting the array back.
solutions.ur: Geele ya garmi se kharab DC connectors replace karein, phir array wapas lagane se pehle dobara test karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: DC insulation failure (PV se earth)

meaning.en: PV insulation to earth is too low. Deye removes the PV input; the manual's step 2 is checking the inverter PE cable.
meaning.ur: PV ka earth ke saath insulation bohat kam hai. Deye PV input disconnect kar deta hai; manual ka step 2 inverter ki PE cable check karna hai.

causes.en: PV panel-to-inverter connection is not firm or not correct.
causes.ur: PV panel se inverter ka connection mazboot ya sahi nahi hai.

causes.en: The PE cable of the inverter is not connected to ground.
causes.ur: Inverter ki PE cable ground se juri nahi hui.

causes.en: DC cable insulation broken by UV, heat, rodents or a sharp edge.
causes.ur: DC cable ki insulation UV, garmi, chuhe ya kisi tez dhaar se kharab hui.

causes.en: PV string shorted to the module frame or a grounded rail.
causes.ur: PV string module frame ya grounded rail par short ho gayi.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and confirm the PV input is dead before any inspection.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke confirm karein ke PV input dead hai, phir hi inspection shuru karein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter PE cable is connected to ground and the earth conductor is continuous.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter ki PE cable ground se juri hui hai aur earth conductor continuous hai.

solutions.en: Inspect every DC connector for full insertion, correct crimp and no water inside the housing.
solutions.ur: Har DC connector ki poori seating, sahi crimp aur housing mein paani na hone ko check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault stays, test one string at a time with the strings disconnected from the inverter and replace the failing cable or connector.
solutions.ur: Fault rahe to strings inverter se disconnect karke ek ek karke test karein aur fail hone wali cable ya connector replace karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: DC busbar unbalanced hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar halves are out of balance. The manual lists very different three-phase load and DC leakage current as the two triggers.
meaning.ur: DC busbar ke do hisse balance mein nahi hain. Manual teen phase ka load bohat different hona aur DC leakage current ko do triggers batata hai.

causes.en: Three-phase load power is very unbalanced between the phases.
causes.ur: Teen phase ka load power phases ke darmiyan bahut unbalanced hai.

causes.en: DC leakage current is present in the PV or DC side.
causes.ur: PV ya DC side mein DC leakage current mojood hai.

causes.en: Busbar sensing or the balancing control has drifted.
causes.ur: Busbar sensing ya balancing control drift kar gaya hai.

solutions.en: Wait a while and check whether the code clears by itself.
solutions.ur: Kuch der intezaar karein aur dekhein ke code khud clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Balance the three phases: shift load from the heaviest phase to the lightest so currents match.
solutions.ur: Teen phases ko balance karein: sabse bhaari phase se load hata kar sabse halkay phase par daalein taake current match kare.

solutions.en: Check for DC leakage current, because the manual lists it as a separate cause of F26.
solutions.ur: DC leakage current check karein, kyunke manual usay F26 ki alag wajah batata hai.

solutions.en: Restart the system two to three times and re-read the code.
solutions.ur: System do se teen baar restart karein aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Balanced loads and no leakage but F26 persists: the busbar sensing channel needs service.
solutions.ur: Load balance ho aur leakage na ho phir bhi F26 rahe to busbar sensing channel ko service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Parallel CAN bus par communication fail

meaning.en: The CAN communication between paralleled inverters is faulty or the communication address setting is wrong.
meaning.ur: Parallel inverters ke darmiyan CAN communication kharab hai ya communication address ki setting ghalti hai.

causes.en: Parallel communication cable connection is loose.
causes.ur: Parallel communication cable ka connection loose hai.

causes.en: Hybrid inverter communication address setting is wrong or duplicated.
causes.ur: Hybrid inverter communication address ki setting ghalti ya duplicate hai.

causes.en: One unit is still booting, so the bus is not yet complete.
causes.ur: Koi aik unit abhi boot ho raha hai, is liye bus mukammal nahi hua.

solutions.en: In parallel mode, check the parallel communication cable connection at every unit.
solutions.ur: Parallel mode mein har unit par parallel communication cable ka connection check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the hybrid inverter communication address setting is unique on each unit and correctly numbered.
solutions.ur: Har unit par hybrid inverter communication address setting unique aur sahi number par check karein.

solutions.en: During the parallel startup period every unit reports F29 until all are ON — judge only after that.
solutions.ur: Parallel startup ke dauran har unit F29 deta hai jab tak sab ON na hon — uske baad hi faisla karein.

solutions.en: If it still exists, power off the set, reseat every comms connector and re-check addressing.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi rahe to set ka power off karke har comms connector dobara baithayein aur addressing dobara check karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Backup load par AC overload fault

meaning.en: The backup load connected is outside the allowed power range, so the inverter drops out.
meaning.ur: Jura hua backup load ijazat shuda power range se bahar hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Backup load power is above the allowed range for this model.
causes.ur: Backup load ki power is model ki ijazat shuda range se upar hai.

causes.en: Large inrush from a motor or compressor on the backup output.
causes.ur: Backup output par motor ya compressor ka bara inrush.

causes.en: Parallel units are sharing the same load but the load is not divided.
causes.ur: Parallel units wohi load share kar rahe hain lekin load baant nahi gaya.

solutions.en: Check the backup load connections and make sure the total is inside the allowed power range.
solutions.ur: Backup load ke connections check karein aur confirm karein ke total ijazat shuda power range ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Open the AC and DC switches, remove the biggest load, then power up and re-check.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC switch khol ke sabse bhaari load hata dein, phir power de kar dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Clamp-meter the backup output current in normal running.
solutions.ur: Backup output ka current normal chalte hue clamp meter se naalein.

solutions.en: On parallel systems confirm the load is split between the units and each unit stays under its own rating.
solutions.ur: Parallel system par confirm karein ke load units mein baanta hua hai aur har unit apni rating ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Fault with a small load points to the output current sensor, which needs board-level service.
solutions.ur: Chhote load par fault ka matlab hai ke output current sensor kharab hai, board level service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.en: Parallel system stop (one unit shut down)
title.ur: Parallel system stop (aik unit band)

meaning.en: One hybrid inverter in the parallel set has shut down, so all the others report F41 and stop.
meaning.ur: Parallel set mein aik hybrid inverter band ho gaya, is liye baqi sab F41 report kar ke ruk jate hain.

causes.en: One parallel unit has shut down on any internal fault.
causes.ur: Koi aik parallel unit kisi bhi internal fault par band ho gaya.

causes.en: One unit's DC switch is off or its supply is missing.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ka DC switch band hai ya usay supply nahi mil raha.

causes.en: Communication address setting is duplicated across the set.
causes.ur: Set ke andar communication address ki setting duplicate hai.

solutions.en: Check the hybrid inverter working status on each unit's LCD one by one.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke LCD par hybrid inverter ki working status ek ek karke check karein.

solutions.en: Find the unit that is in OFF state and clear its own fault code first.
solutions.ur: OFF state mein jo unit hai use dhoondhein aur pehle uska apna fault code clear karein.

solutions.en: If all units are ON and F41 is still shown, power off the set and reseat the CAN and comms cabling.
solutions.ur: Agar sab units ON hain aur phir bhi F41 dikh raha hai to set ka power off karke CAN aur comms wiring dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Then restart from the master and confirm every unit joins the parallel set.
solutions.ur: Phir master se restart karke confirm karein ke har unit parallel set mein shaamil ho gaya.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Grid ki AC line voltage kam hai

meaning.en: Grid AC voltage is out of the standard specification range, so the inverter stops grid-tied output.
meaning.ur: Grid ka AC voltage standard specification range se bahar hai, is liye inverter grid output band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Actual grid AC voltage is below the specification range.
causes.ur: Asal grid ka AC voltage specification range se kam hai.

causes.en: Grid AC cables are not firmly or correctly connected.
causes.ur: Grid ke AC cables mazboot ya sahi tarah se connected nahi hain.

causes.en: Long or undersized AC cable causing a voltage drop at the inverter.
causes.ur: Lamba ya chhota AC cable inverter par voltage drop kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid protection window set tighter than the utility's actual variation.
causes.ur: Grid protection range utility ki asli variation se sakht kar di gayi hai.

solutions.en: Measure the AC voltage with a true-RMS meter at the inverter terminals and compare it with the specification range in the manual.
solutions.ur: True-RMS meter se inverter terminals par AC voltage naalein aur manual ki specification range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch off power and re-tighten every grid AC cable terminal, checking L1/L2/N and PE for correct landing.
solutions.ur: Power off karke har grid AC cable terminal dobara tighten karein aur L1, L2, N aur PE ki sahi jagah landing check karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is only low at the inverter, shorten or upsize the grid AC cable run.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf inverter par voltage kam ho to grid AC cable ki lambai kam karein ya cable size barhayein.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to return to normal and restart; contact Deye if the fault will not clear.
solutions.ur: Grid normal hone ka intezaar karke restart karein; fault na hathe to Deye se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Backup battery fault, battery theek nahi

meaning.en: The battery connected to the backup port is not healthy. Deye points at battery status, voltage, SOC and parameter mismatch.
meaning.ur: Backup port se juri battery theek haal mein nahi hai. Deye battery status, voltage, SOC aur parameters ki mismatch ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage or SOC is outside what the inverter accepts.
causes.ur: Battery voltage ya SOC inverter ki ijazat se bahar hai.

causes.en: Battery parameters such as charge/discharge current or float voltage are not the same on all units.
causes.ur: Sab units par battery parameters jaise charge ya discharge current ya float voltage aik jaise nahi hain.

causes.en: One parallel unit has a different battery type or capacity setting.
causes.ur: Kisi aik parallel unit par battery type ya capacity ki setting alag hai.

causes.en: A cell in the pack has failed or the pack temperature is out of range.
causes.ur: Pack ki koi cell fail ho gayi hai ya pack temperature range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Check each battery's status: measure its voltage and SOC and write them down for every unit.
solutions.ur: Har battery ka status check karein: uska voltage aur SOC naalein aur har unit ka likh lein.

solutions.en: With DC off, compare the battery type, capacity, charge current and float voltage settings across all units and make them identical.
solutions.ur: DC off karke sab units ka battery type, capacity, charge current aur float voltage setting compare karein aur sab ko aik jaisa kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery's internal resistance or ask for its BMS history to find a failed cell.
solutions.ur: Har battery ki internal resistance naalein ya failed cell dhoondne ke liye BMS ki history mangwayein.

solutions.en: If one pack is clearly worse, isolate that unit and service or replace that battery only — do not mix packs with different capacities.
solutions.ur: Agar aik pack saaf tor par kharab ho to us unit ko alag kar ke sirf wohi battery service ya replace karein — alag capacity ke packs aik saath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Fault clears and stays away: if not, contact Deye as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Fault clear ho jaye to theek hai; na hatne par manual ke mutabiq Deye se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Grid frequency zyada hai

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the specification range, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specification range se bahar hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Actual grid frequency is out of the specification range.
causes.ur: Asal grid frequency specification range se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC cables are not firmly or correctly connected.
causes.ur: AC cables mazboot ya sahi tarah se connected nahi hain.

causes.en: Genset supply with an unstable governor, or a wrong 50/60 Hz grid type setting.
causes.ur: Unstable governor wala genset supply, ya 50 ya 60 Hz ki galat grid type setting.

solutions.en: Check the frequency with a clamp meter or multimeter in frequency mode at the AC input.
solutions.ur: AC input par clamp meter ya multimeter ko frequency mode mein set karke frequency check karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading against the frequency range in the manual specification.
solutions.ur: Reading ko manual specification ke frequency range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the grid type / frequency setting matches the actual supply.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid type aur frequency ki setting asal supply se match karti hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and re-tighten all AC cable terminals, then restart once the frequency is in range.
solutions.ur: Power off karke sab AC cable terminals dobara tighten karein, phir frequency range mein aane par restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Grid frequency kam hai

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the specification range, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specification range se neeche hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Weak grid is dragging frequency below the window.
causes.ur: Kamzor grid frequency ko window se neeche gira raha hai.

causes.en: AC cables are not firmly or correctly connected.
causes.ur: AC cables mazboot ya sahi tarah se connected nahi hain.

causes.en: Genset running too slow, or 50/60 Hz grid type set against the real supply.
causes.ur: Genset bohat dheere chal raha hai, ya asal supply ke khilaf 50 ya 60 Hz grid type set hai.

solutions.en: Measure the frequency at the AC input and compare it with the manual's specification range.
solutions.ur: AC input par frequency naalein aur manual ki specification range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the grid type / frequency setting and set it to the real supply frequency.
solutions.ur: Grid type aur frequency setting check karein aur use asal supply frequency par set karein.

solutions.en: If a genset feeds the inverter, adjust its speed and let the frequency settle before restart.
solutions.ur: Agar genset inverter ko power de raha ho to uski speed theek karein aur restart se pehle frequency settle hone dein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the AC cable terminals and restart when the grid recovers.
solutions.ur: AC cable terminals dobara tighten karein aur grid theek hone par restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

aliases: DC busbar voltage is too high

title.en: DC busbar voltage is too high
title.ur: DC busbar voltage bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar voltage is above the limit. Deye tells you to check battery voltage and the PV input voltage range.
meaning.ur: DC busbar voltage limit se upar hai. Deye kehta hai ke battery voltage aur PV input voltage ka range check karein.

causes.en: Battery voltage is above the allowed DC window for this model.
causes.ur: Battery voltage is model ke ijazat shuda DC range se upar hai.

causes.en: PV string voltage is above the maximum DC input, e.g. too many modules in series for cold conditions.
causes.ur: PV string ka voltage maximum DC input se upar hai, jaise thand mein modules ki series tadaad zyada ho.

causes.en: Battery type or float voltage is set higher than the battery can safely hold.
causes.ur: Battery type ya float voltage battery se zyada set hai jo battery safely hold kar sakta hai.

causes.en: PV input voltage detection has drifted and the unit is over-charging the bus.
causes.ur: PV input voltage detection drift kar gaya hai aur unit bus ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

solutions.en: With AC and DC off, measure the battery terminal voltage on a multimeter and compare it with the manual's DC window.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke multimeter se battery terminal voltage naalein aur manual ke DC range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV string open-circuit voltage and confirm it is within the allowed PV input range on cold mornings.
solutions.ur: PV string ki open-circuit voltage naalein aur confirm karein ke thand ke subah bhi ye ijazat shuda PV input range mein hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series if the cold-morning Voc exceeds the limit.
solutions.ur: Agar thand ki subah Voc limit cross kare to series mein modules ki tadaad kam karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery type and float/charge voltage settings in the LCD match the fitted battery.
solutions.ur: LCD mein battery type aur float ya charge voltage setting check karein ke lagay huay battery se match karti hai.

solutions.en: If measured voltages are inside the window, the busbar voltage detection circuit needs service.
solutions.ur: Nikalay huay voltages range ke andar hon to busbar voltage detection circuit ko service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

aliases: DC busbar voltage is too low

title.en: DC busbar voltage is too low
title.ur: DC busbar voltage bohat kam hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar voltage is below the limit. Deye tells you to check the battery voltage and to charge from PV or grid.
meaning.ur: DC busbar voltage limit se neeche hai. Deye kehta hai ke battery voltage check karein aur PV ya grid se charge karein.

causes.en: Battery voltage has dropped below the allowed window, usually deep discharge.
causes.ur: Battery voltage ijazat shuda window se neeche gir gaya hai, aam tor par gehri discharge.

causes.en: PV input voltage is too low to charge, e.g. early morning or shaded array.
causes.ur: PV input voltage charge karne ke liye bohat kam hai, jaise subah jaldi ya array par parda.

causes.en: Battery fuse, connector or BMS contact is open.
causes.ur: Battery fuse, connector ya BMS ka contact khula hua hai.

causes.en: Charge current setting is too low, so the bus never recovers.
causes.ur: Charge current setting bohat kam hai, is liye bus kabhi recover nahi hota.

solutions.en: Check whether the battery voltage is too low, using a multimeter on the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery terminals par voltage check karein ke battery voltage bohat kam to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the battery is too low, charge it with PV or grid exactly as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage kam ho to manual ke mutabiq use PV ya grid se charge karein.

solutions.en: Open the AC and DC switches and check the battery fuse, connector seating and BMS contact.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC switch khol ke battery fuse, connector ki seating aur BMS contact check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the charge current and float voltage settings are not set too low for the battery.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke charge current aur float voltage ki setting battery ke liye bohat kam to nahi rakhi gayi.

solutions.en: Battery charged but the bus stays low: the busbar voltage sampling wiring is faulty.
solutions.ur: Battery charge ho jaye phir bhi bus kam rahe to busbar voltage sampling wiring kharab hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: BMS se communication nahi hai

meaning.en: Communication between the hybrid inverter and the battery BMS is lost while BMS_Err-Stop is active.
meaning.ur: BMS_Err-Stop active hone ke dauran hybrid inverter aur battery BMS ka communication nahi hai.

causes.en: BMS_Err-Stop is enabled and the BMS has dropped the CAN link.
causes.ur: BMS_Err-Stop on hai aur BMS ne CAN link chhor diya hai.

causes.en: Comms cable is loose, reversed or on the wrong pins.
causes.ur: Comms cable loose, ulti ya galat pins par hai.

causes.en: BMS is asleep, on low SOC, or has latched its own fault.
causes.ur: BMS so raha hai, low SOC par hai ya apna fault latch kar chuka hai.

causes.en: Battery protocol or type setting does not match the fitted BMS.
causes.ur: Battery protocol ya type ki setting lagay huay BMS se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Check the comms cable seating and pinout at both the inverter and the BMS, then re-seat it.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur BMS dono taraf comms cable ki seating aur pinout check karke use dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Confirm the BMS is powered, awake and not stopped on its own low voltage or SOC limit.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke BMS power on, jaag hua aur apne low voltage ya SOC limit par band nahi hua.

solutions.en: Set the battery type and protocol on the LCD to the exact model fitted.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery type aur protocol woh exact model set karein jo lagaya hua hai.

solutions.en: If you do not want this stop behaviour, disable BMS_Err-Stop on the LCD — only after the pack is proven good.
solutions.ur: Agar ye stop behaviour nahi chahiye to LCD se BMS_Err-Stop disable karein, magar sirf tab jab pack theek sabit ho.

solutions.en: Fault persists: the BMS module or its CAN transceiver is faulty and needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to BMS module ya uska CAN transceiver kharab hai aur replacement chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: DRMs0_stop, demand response ne band kiya

meaning.en: The DRM port has commanded the inverter to stop. Deye states the DRM function is for the Australia market only.
meaning.ur: DRM port ne inverter ko band karne ka command diya hai. Deye kehta hai ke DRM function sirf Australia market ke liye hai.

causes.en: The utility or a demand response device has asserted the DRM pin.
causes.ur: Utility ya kisi demand response device ne DRM pin assert kar diya hai.

causes.en: The DRM wiring on the DRS/D com port is shorted or connected to the wrong pin.
causes.ur: DRS ya D com port par DRM wiring short ho gayi hai ya galat pin se juri hai.

causes.en: The DRM function is left enabled on a non-Australian installation with a floating or live DRS pin.
causes.ur: Non-Australian installation par DRM function chala chhuda hai aur DRS pin floating ya live hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the DRM function is active on the unit; the manual makes this step 2.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke DRM function unit par active hai ya nahi, manual isay step 2 batata hai.

solutions.en: At the DRS port, measure voltage to ground with a multimeter; a live DRS/D pin is what commands the stop.
solutions.ur: DRS port par multimeter se ground ke qeemat voltage naalein; live DRS ya D pin hi stop ka command deta hai.

solutions.en: If the site is not in Australia, disable DRM in the settings and disconnect the DRS wires, then confirm the pin is dead.
solutions.ur: Agar site Australia mein nahi hai to settings mein DRM disable karein aur DRS wires disconnect karke confirm karein ke pin dead hai.

solutions.en: Restart the system; if it still cannot return to normal contact Deye as the manual says.
solutions.ur: System restart karein; phir bhi normal par na aaye to manual ke mutabiq Deye se rabta karein.

notes.en: In Pakistan this code almost always means a mis-wired or floating DRS pin on the comms connector, not an actual utility demand response event.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein ye code aksar DRS pin ki galat wiring ya floating pin ka matlab hota hai, asal utility demand response event ka nahi.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: ARC fault, PV mein arc detect hua

meaning.en: The PV arc fault function has tripped. Clear the cable fault, then clear the alarm on the inverter.
meaning.ur: PV arc fault function trigger ho gaya hai. Cable ka fault theek karein, phir inverter par alarm clear karein.

causes.en: DC connector not fully mated, so contacts arc under load.
causes.ur: DC connector poora fit nahi hai, is liye load ke neeche contacts arc karte hain.

causes.en: Burnt or badly crimped DC plug.
causes.ur: Jala hua ya kharab crimp kiya hua DC plug.

causes.en: PV cable insulation damaged by UV, heat or rodents.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuhe se PV cable ki insulation kharab hui.

solutions.en: Check the PV module cable connections and clear the fault on the cable side first.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV module cable ke connections check karke us taraf ka fault theek karein.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch, confirm DC is dead, then pull and inspect every MC4 pair by hand.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke DC dead confirm karein, phir har MC4 pair haath se nikal kar check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any connector that is loose, heat damaged or wrongly crimped.
solutions.ur: Loose, garmi se kharab ya galat crimp wala connector replace kar dein.

solutions.en: After the cable fault is gone, clear the fault and seek Deye help if it will not clear.
solutions.ur: Cable fault khatam hone ke baad fault clear karein aur na hatne par Deye se madad lein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

title.ur: Heat sink bohat garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The heat sink is too hot, so the inverter shut down. Deye asks you to check the ambient temperature and restart after 10 minutes.
meaning.ur: Heat sink bohat garm hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Deye kehta hai ke aam temperature check karein aur 10 minute baad restart karein.

causes.en: Working environment temperature is too high for the installation.
causes.ur: Installation ki jagah ka working environment temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Fan is faulty or its cable is not connected, so no forced cooling.
causes.ur: Fan kharab hai ya uska cable connected nahi, is liye forced cooling nahi hai.

causes.en: Heat sink is choked with dust or the unit is boxed in with no airflow.
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se band hai ya unit aisa band hai ke hawa nahi aati.

solutions.en: Check whether the work environment temperature is too high; measure it where the unit is installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke work environment temperature zyada to nahi hai; jahan unit laga hai wahan temperature naalein.

solutions.en: Turn the inverter off for 10 minutes and restart, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter ko 10 minute ke liye band karke restart karein.

solutions.en: With the unit off, check the fan connector and confirm the fan spins freely.
solutions.ur: Unit off karke fan connector check karein aur confirm karein ke fan azaad chalta hai.

solutions.en: Vacuum the heat sink fins and keep the manual's clearance around the unit for airflow.
solutions.ur: Heat sink ki fins vacuum karein aur unit ke aas paas manual ki clearance hawa ke liye rakhein.

solutions.en: Still tripping in a cool ventilated space: the NTC temperature sensor or the fan itself is faulty.
solutions.ur: Thande aur hawa wale kamre mein bhi aaye to NTC temperature sensor ya fan kharab hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)
